description: This file is a Java class named UserController that defines REST API endpoints for user management in a banking application. It handles user registration, updates, and retrieval operations, interacting with UserService and KeycloakUserService.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller that manages user-related operations such as registration, updating, and fetching user data.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to register a new user, using data from the request body.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update user details for a specified user ID.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of all users.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific user by ID.
